item.title: AI 2027: “Horizon of about three weeks of work” is ahead of the scenario
item.description: “Horizon of about three weeks of work”: the observatory’s assessment goes from “not yet assessable” to “ahead”. The authors frame it with METR’s 80% horizon, which does not measure reliably above 16 hours, and the last model it has measured was published on 7 Apr 2026. The observatory checks it against MirrorCode, from Epoch and METR: reimplementing whole programs from their behaviour, with tasks that would take an engineer weeks. The first model to reach 80% is Claude Opus 5 (max), with 87.8%, published on 24 Jul 2026. Rule (the observatory’s reading): “consistent” if, when the deadline expires, the best result reaches 80%. MirrorCode only covers programming and its score is not the success rate on three-week tasks. Before: “not yet assessable”. Scenario deadline: late 2026. It is in the briefing because the observatory’s assessment of an AI 2027 milestone changes. Detected on 2026-11-10. Source: Epoch AI (https://epoch.ai/benchmarks/mirrorcode).
